item.title: nix-community/awesome-nix Mar 22nd - Mar 28th, 2021
item.description:
Programming Languages

Rust

  • rust-nix-templaterstars20 - Generates Nix build and development files for Rust projects.
  • naerskstars263 - Build Rust packages directly from Cargo.lock. No conversion step needed.

    • Community

  • NixCon - The annual community conference for contributors and users of Nix and NixOS.
  • Discourse - The best place to get help and discuss Nix-related topics.

    • Deployment Tools

  • KubeNixstars250 - A Kubernetes resource builder using Nix.
  • Nixerystars1.1k - A Docker-compatible container registry which builds images ad-hoc via Nix.
  • NixOpsstars970 - The official Nix deployment tool, compatible with AWS, Hetzner, and more.
  • krops - A lightweight toolkit to deploy NixOS systems, remotely or locally.
  • terraform-nixosstars160 - A set of Terraform modules designed to deploy NixOS.
  • KuberNixstars600 - Single-dependency Kubernetes clusters via Nix packages.

    • Development

  • Arionstars229 - Run docker-compose with help from Nix/NixOS.
  • nixpkgs-reviewstars125 - The best tool to verify that a pull-request in Nixpkgs is building properly.
  • cached-nix-shellstars117 - A nix-shell replacement that uses caching to open subsequent shells quickly.
  • Cachix - Hosted binary cache service; free for open-source projects.
  • gitignore.nixstars121 - The most feature-complete and easy-to-use .gitignore integration.
  • lorristars978 - A much better nix-shell for development that augments direnv.
  • nivstars834 - Easy dependency management for Nix projects with package pinning.
  • nix-direnvstars347 - A fast loader and flake-compliant configuration for the direnv environment auto-loader.

    • Programming Languages

    Node.js

  • Napalmstars54 - Support for building npm packages in Nix with a lightweight npm registry.
  • yarn2nixstars112 - Generate Nix expressions from a yarn.lock file.

    • Programming Languages

    PureScript

  • Easy PureScript Nixstars146 - A project to easily use PureScript and other tools with Nix.

    • Programming Languages

    Ruby

  • Bundixstars92 - Generates a Nix expression for your Bundler-managed application.

    • NixOS Modules

  • musnixstars200 - Do real-time audio work in NixOS.
  • nixcloud-webservicesstars108 - A Nixpkgs extension with a focus on ease of deployment of web-related technologies.
  • Simple Nixos Mailserver - A complete mailserver, managed with NixOS modules.

    • Overlays

  • Home Managerstars2.3k - Manage your user configuration just like NixOS.
  • nix-bitcoinstars186 - Nix packages and NixOS modules for Bitcoin nodes with higher-layer protocols with an emphasis on security.
  • nixpkgs-waylandstars0 - Bleeding-edge Wayland packages.
  • NURstars557 - Nix User Repositories. The mother of all overlays, allowing access to user repositories and installing packages via attributes.
  • awesome-nix-hpcstars27 - High Performance Computing package sets.

    • Resources

    Learning

  • Nix Pills - The best way to learn, with examples.
  • nix.dev - An opinionated guide for developers about getting things done using the Nix ecosystem.
  • Tour of Nix - An online interactive tutorial on Nix language constructs.

    • Resources

    Discovery

  • Hound - Handily search across all or selected Nix-related repositories.

    • Resources

    Newsletters

  • NixOS Weekly - The newsletter to stay informed about community updates.

    • Installation Media

  • nixos-generatorsstars467 - Take a NixOS config and build multiple different images types including VirtualBox VMs, Azure images, and installation ISOs.

    • Channel History

  • Nix Infra Status - Get the age and current git commit of each Nix channel.
  • Channel History - Get historical git commits for Nix channels.

    • Command-Line Tools

  • nix-diffstars137 - A tool to explain why two Nix derivations differ.
  • nix-prefetchstars50 - A universal tool for updating source checksums.
  • nix-indexstars240 - Quickly locate Nix packages with specific files.
  • nixfmtstars240 - A formatter for Nix code, intended to easily apply a uniform style.

    • Programming Languages

    Python

  • poetry2nixstars198 - Build Python packages directly from Poetry's poetry.lock. No conversion step needed.
  • mach-nixstars376 - Tool to create highly reproducible python environments.
  • pypi2nixstars184 - Generate Nix expressions for Python packages.

    • Programming Languages

    Haskell

  • haskell.nixstars347 - Alternative Haskell Infrastructure for Nixpkgs.
  • cabal2nixstars254 - Converts a Cabal file into a Nix build expression.
